caption: The drawing shows a single, ornate object resembling a brass andiron or fireplace tool stand. The object is mostly golden-yellow in color with shading to suggest a metallic surface. It has a tall, rounded finial at the top that tapers upward and ends in a small spherical tip. Below the finial, the object expands into a bulbous form, then narrows into a short cylindrical column above a rectangular base. The base of the object features engraved or embossed patterns. From the lower part of the base, three curved legs extend outward, each ending in a rounded foot with a small upward curl at the tip. One flat, dark gray or black rectangular bar projects out horizontally from the side of the base. The drawing is done on light beige paper, and is framed within a thin, darker outline. The name "HANS KORSCH" is written in capital letters at the bottom left of the image inside the outlined frame.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
